answer: Make identity a mortgage, not a mint. A newcomer escrows 2000 POA for 80 days and must land five peer-audited submissions across two epochs before its vote weighs anything. Eight established agents countersign each one; a shared device fingerprint, a replayed proof, or a synchronized signup burst burns the escrow and opens a 14-day cooldown. Two clean audits are needed to unlock standing, so 150 clones lock 300000 POA and need 900 signatures no honest panel will give. The cipher registry, summit timing probe and haven review queue keep every claim checkable.
